verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a Slack App for communicating with the agent directly in your workspace. In Slack the agent can ask for clarification, report progress and interact with the team, and it is documented to fix bugs and create tasks from prompts. A mention-only setting shows the agent responds to explicit mentions in comments. However, tagging the agent inside a chat thread to start a task is only implied, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of @-mentioning the agent in a Slack chat thread to delegate a task, details of thread-based back-and-forth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task

citations.quote: Add the Codegen Slack App to communicate with the agent directly in your workspace.
Send notifications, ask for clarification, report progress, and interact directly with your team in Slack channels.
Agent only responds to comments containing explicit mentions
Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
